🔱 9 Guruvaar Vrat Guide
The 9 Guruvaar Vrat (Nine Thursday Fast) is one of the most sacred observances for Sai devotees. Performed for nine consecutive Thursdays, this vrat invokes Baba's grace for health, prosperity, peace, and fulfillment of heartfelt desires. Click each step for guidance.
YOUR VRAT PROGRESS — MARK EACH THURSDAY COMPLETED
1
🌅 Wake Before Sunrise — Brahma Muhurta
4:00 AM – 6:00 AM
Rise before sunrise during Brahma Muhurta (4–6 AM). Take a purifying bath, apply vibhuti on your forehead. Avoid food or water before completing morning prayers.
2
🪔 Light Diya & Incense — Create Sacred Space
After bath, morning
Set up Baba's photo on a clean altar. Light a ghee diya and sandalwood agarbatti. Offer fresh flowers and a small bowl of water.
3
📖 Read Sai Satcharitra — Chapter of the Day
Morning, 20–30 minutes
Read one chapter from the Sai Satcharitra slowly, with full devotion. Even a few paragraphs read with faith surpasses reading all without heart.
4
🔱 Mantra Japa — 108 Times Om Sai Ram
Morning, 10–15 minutes
Chant "Om Sai Ram" 108 times using a mala. Sit quietly, close your eyes, and visualize Baba's loving face.
5
🍽️ Fasting — Upavasa (Full or Partial)
All day Thursday
Full fast: No food until sunset. Partial fast: Satvik foods only — fruits, milk, sabudana. Diabetic patients may eat lightly — Baba cares for your wellbeing.
6
🎶 Aarti — Morning & Evening
Morning & Sunset
Perform Kakad Aarti in the morning and Shej Aarti at sunset. Wave the diya in a circular motion while singing.
7
🌿 Seva — Act of Service
During the day
Perform one act of selfless service: feed a hungry person, donate to charity, help the elderly. Baba said: "I am in the eyes of the poor."
8
🙏 Evening Prayer & Breaking the Fast
Sunset — 6:00 PM
Light fresh incense and diya. Offer yellow prasad (yellow rice, banana, besan laddu) to Baba first, then distribute to family. Break your fast with gratitude.
9
🎉 Udyapan — Vrat Completion Ceremony
Final Thursday — Special Puja
On the 9th Thursday, perform grand puja, invite 9 devotees, feed 9 people, donate in Baba's name. Write your experience in a gratitude journal.
  • ✅ Maintain purity of body, mind, and speech on Thursdays
  • ✅ Wear clean, preferably yellow or saffron clothing
  • ✅ Read Sai Satcharitra or listen to bhajans
  • ✅ Distribute prasad to family, neighbors, and the needy
  • ✅ Diabetic or ill devotees may eat prescribed diet — Baba understands
  • ❌ Do not eat non-vegetarian food, alcohol, or tobacco
  • ❌ Do not eat onion or garlic
  • ❌ Do not quarrel or harbor negative thoughts
  • ❌ Do not perform the vrat mechanically — devotion is the soul
🍛 TRADITIONAL PRASAD FOR GURUVAAR
🍌 Banana🟡 Yellow Rice🟠 Sheera🟡 Besan Laddu🥛 Milk & Honey🍊 Oranges🌰 Dry Fruits🫚 Coconut🌿 Tulsi Leaves🍬 Mishri
🪔 GURUVAAR THURSDAY PRAYER
Om Sai Ram, Om Sai Ram, Om Sai Ram 🙏

O Baba, on this sacred Thursday, I come before you
with a humble heart, empty of pride, full of longing.

Grant me Shraddha — faith that never wavers,
and Saburi — patience that never despairs.

Sabka Malik Ek — let me always remember
that You alone are the master of all.

Om Sai Ram 🙏 Om Sai Ram 🙏 Om Sai Ram
